posts.title: Titan II Missile Silo Control Room
posts.description: I came across Beth Mathews' post, "Why So Many Control Rooms Were Seafoam Green" , and the post image of the post immediately made me think of some pictures I took back in February. Why So Many Control Rooms Were Seafoam Green The Color Theory Behind Industrial Seafoam

posts.title: Simulating a glowing fireplace
posts.description: David Capper wrote a simply fantastic blog post detailing how he took a long string of WS2812B LEDs and an RP2040 and turned it into a glowing fireplace simulation. The post details his work on black body radiation and has some interactive bits showing how the ember simulations work. I

posts.title: Narcissus
posts.description: A stark black and white photo of a yellow daffodil My daffodils (from the genus Narcissus, I’ve learned) have bloomed, and the tulips won’t be far behind. Spring is getting here in a hurry!
